_about: Experiment E2: can PPO get past waiting? v0 against two reward terms (wait, bomb_survived), a higher entropy bonus, and training against noisy25 bots. 5 seeds per variant, each judged by the final evaluation protocol (all 5 levels, 200 games each). Run with: python -m rl.run_ppo_seeds experiments/ppo/e2_waiting.json (keys starting with _ are comments).
name: e2_waiting
_parallel: 1: the long runs train on the GPU, one run at a time.

config._total_timesteps: SET ME: the steps per seed, from the laptop benchmark. The plan refuses to start while this is null.
config._eval_every: SET ME: the evaluation interval, from the benchmark (conclusion.smallest_eval_every_for_5_percent or larger).
config._device_vec_env_torch_threads: SET FROM THE BENCHMARK: device (cpu or cuda), vec_env (dummy or subproc) and torch_threads for one run at a time.

_variants: Every variant is v0 plus the overrides below. wait = -0.002 per WAIT (or refused BOMB); bomb_survived = 0.05 per own bomb that exploded and broke at least one crate while the agent is alive; ent_coef 0.05 (v0: 0.01). The noisy25 variant trains against noisy25 bots but draws its learning curve against random bots, like the others.
